payload.rebuttal: fixed: The witness checked only `"§5.4" in line`, `"§5.4." not in line`, and `"§3.2" not in line`, so a comment citing §5.4 plus any other section, like §9.9, still passed. I replaced those three checks with a regex that extracts every section token (`§\d+(?:\.\d+)*`) from the comment line and asserts the full list equals exactly `["§5.4"]`. I verified the fix against the critic's probe and every wrong version named in the spec: §3.2 alone, §3.2 and §5.4 together, §5.4 plus §9.9, no section at all, and §5.4.1 alone all now fail, while the correct comment citing only §5.4 passes.
